Position: APPLICATION CONSULTANT - TRIRIGA

Location: Remote based in USA


We are looking for a seasoned Application Consultant to join our Professional Services Practice. The Application Consultant is responsible for providing the interface between our clients and our technical team to successfully implement TRIRIGA into the client environment. The Application Consultant will facilitate configuration and deployment of solutions to improve client’s operational performance. The Application Consultant will conduct analysis, requirements clarification and functional design specification for the implementation of TRIRIGA solution into the client’s technology environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a trusted Advisor to clients. Fully engage with clients as the subject matter expert to develop recommendations.
Create clear and comprehensive specifications for TRIRIGA implementation to meet the client’s requirements.
Define and document client’s specific business needs and application requirements.
Create the process diagrams, use cases, gap analysis, functional design document and reporting specifications.
Develop strong customer relationships to ensure all documentation, data and reports are accurate and comprehensive.
Troubleshoot issues and problems discovered on customer’s installation.
Oversee the Quality Assurance function
Collaborate cross functionally; Provide technical and analytical guidance to Application Development team.
Work with databases, web services, Java and other technologies as required.

Required


10 years + experience with TRIRIGA
10 years+ experience creating functional design documentation, leading process workshops, leading design sessions, creating the process diagrams, use cases, and gap analysis.
5 years + experience, with an emphasis on Operations and Maintenance (CMMS) functionality
Strong and effective communication and presentation skills
Ability to work collaboratively in teams and develop meaningful relationships to achieve common goals
Problem solving – Well versed in providing IT solutions to address the needs of the business
Experience in the Corporate Real Estate or Facility Management industry
